items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And he was trying all kinds of stuff on the drums. Alvin Atkinson. Wonderful. He was just going for it.

ctx.x: Well I think about that less and less. I thought about it when I was younger and when I had a lesson with Ray Brown, who was known for playing on top of the beat so to speak, or other musicians would say he played really on top of the beat. When I asked Ray about it Ray was like well, he said, “I like to give the music an edge but I don’t like it to get too fast, but I like it to have an edge.” So he liked to really propel the beat I think, you know what I mean? Whether you call that top of the beat or whatever.…
Well when you book your own gigs as a leader, I’m curious about your phone book or whatever. Do you have indicators of —
